root_cause: Two independent controller paths inferred the same next numeric loop ID without an atomic durable reservation.
impact: Durable log ambiguity only; branches, command IDs, sessions, PRs, validation evidence and publication paths remained distinct.
resolution: Both results were preserved without mixing evidence.
Loop 059 was reserved with create-only automation/command_bus/loop_id_claims/059.json before dispatch.
Command-bus README, semi-auto operating procedure and Jules prompt specification now require durable loop-ID reservation before dispatch.
prevention: One create-only loop_id_claims/<NNN>.json per numeric loop ID; claimed IDs are never recycled; ambiguous writes require readback; retry=0.
